_comment: The real overhead camera (set up Oct 18; pixel scale re-measured on the roam1 footage, 2026-10-21) (docs/experiments/E00-measurement-check/README.md, 'Setup as built'). Use: python tools/sim/simulate.py --config tools/sim/configs/real_oct18.json --out <dir>. Only the settings listed here differ from the defaults (simulate.py --write-config shows them all). Not modelled: the black-and-white picture (the simulator has no grayscale setting; the real camera has saturation 0).

camera._comment: Overhead USB camera, 640 x 480 at 25 fps, looking about straight down (roam1's floor calibration: 8.8 deg off vertical). Pixel scale MEASURED on the roam1 footage (2026-10-21, board corners): 2.19-2.52 px/cm across the board, mean 2.34 -> floor_width_cm = 640 / 2.34 = 273.5 cm across the picture. (This file said 3.4 px/cm / 188 cm until 2026-10-21b: wrong for the camera as it is now.) Lens HEIGHT UNKNOWN: never measured; the corners cannot pin it down (the calibration assumed 262). height_cm below is a placeholder the simulator needs: with the pixel scale fixed it only changes perspective (where robot tops 4 cm up land: under 2%). Do not use it as a measurement. Floor origin (0, 0) at the bottom-right of the picture, x up the picture, y to the left: yaw -90. No boxes.

session._comment: The board is 122 x 122 cm (48 x 48 in) plywood with no tape axes: its edges are drawn as the 'tape lines'. The simulator starts every route from one pose; (20, 40) facing +x keeps the straight 100 cm run, the 50 cm square and the L on the board and in view (the real sheet uses a separate start spot per route).
